items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: The interviewee (Emile Barnes) does not speak about Rene. The interviewer mentions Rene ('Rene was playing shows', 'when Rene would get a band together'), but the interviewee only responds to general questions about the music style ('It's fun', 'I like a big line band') without confirming any person

ctx.x: You saw him the first night you were in town?
No, no, but the second one. See, first I called Rene, and then Rene told me about Big Eye Lewis, then I met this guy Art Schreiber there, and he told me about the hominé, and we went down there.
All in one night, all in that one weekend?
